text:
Alex K: Quick question — new hire Lina (starts Mon) is remote in a different state and her BG check hit an address mismatch. Also asking whether she needs to do I-9 in person or if we can use an authorized rep.
Priya S: Ah — thanks for flagging. Two separate things: 1) BG check address mismatch: send the Checkr screenshot + candidate confirmation. I can ping security if it needs manual review. 2) I-9: for US remote hires we can use an authorized representative process — candidate signs Section 1, we have someone we trust inspect originals and sign Section 2. We reimburse notary fees if candidate uses a notary.
Alex K: She replied she has a notarized copy from a UPS store but Checkr still flagged the address. Screenshot attached (link). She wants day-1 to be smooth.
Sam T: I can offer to be the authorized rep on Monday (I'll be on-site). If Lina wants in-person verification she can come to HQ at 10:30 — short window for badge pickup. Otherwise reimburse notary and we log the rep in Greenhouse.
John L: FYI security prefers we avoid using recruiters as reps if possible — better to use people-ops or facilities staff. Maria in facilities can meet for badge pickup and do Section 2.
Maria R: I can do 10:30 slot on Monday. Please add me to the calendar invite with candidate contact. Also confirm laptop pickup location (1st floor ops desk) and that logistics knows to hold it.
Priya S: Great — plan: Maria meets Lina at 10:30 for I-9 Section 2 + badge, Sam covers laptop handoff if facilities delayed. I'll open a Checkr ticket: please DM me the mismatch screenshot and Lina's confirmation of current address. I'll also submit the notary reimbursement form as backup.
Alex K: Sounds good. One more: payroll asked Lina to complete W-4 and direct deposit before first payroll cutoff (Fri EOD). Can we nudge her?
Priya S: I'll send the checklist DM with links: W-4 PDF, direct deposit portal, and benefits enrollment link. Also note: if she needs tax treaty forms (unlikely for US hire) payroll will reach out.
HR Bot: Reminder: onboarding checklist for new hires — https://redwood-internal/people-ops/onboarding-checklist. Auto-reminder scheduled 48h before start.
Sam T: I'll text Lina the time + Maria's name and the campus entry instructions. Also will confirm whether she used a notary so we can skip in-person if docs are verified.
Alex K: Thanks all. Priya — can you confirm once Checkr cleared so I can finalize her badge access?
Priya S: Will do. If Checkr requires docs from candidate we'll ask Lina to upload a utility bill + government ID. Otherwise we'll mark as cleared and Maria can issue badge on site.
John L: Small note on compliance: keep a copy of the rep form in the HR file. Maria please drop a signed Section 2 scan into the secure folder after completion.
Maria R: Will upload scan to secure folder immediately after meeting.
Alex K: Appreciate it — trying to avoid frustrating Day 1 for Lina. :slightly_smiling_face:
Priya S: Fingers crossed. I'll update this thread when Checkr ticket is resolved and after I confirm the W-4 completion.
HR Bot: Checkr ticket created: #CHK-7412 — assigned to Priya S.
Alex K: Thanks — keep me posted.
Priya S: Update 15:30: Checkr marked as "review required" pending utility bill. Lina sent a PDF; I uploaded it. Marking as under review by vendor.
Alex K: Got it. Thanks Priya.
Priya S: Final update 18:20: Checkr cleared. Maria confirmed I-9 done and badge issued. W-4 & direct deposit done by Lina. Closing the loop! :tada:
